summary: Beyond Meat, Inc. filed a Form 8-K disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements to retire approximately $15.0 million principal amount of its outstanding 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 at a purchase price of 96% of face value. In exchange, the Company will issue shares of its common stock based on a VWAP calculation over three trading days beginning September 23, 2026, with a floor price of $7.4009 per share. An initial 1,097,444 shares will be issued, with up to 848,265 additional true-up shares possible at final settlement on or about September 28, 2026. The transaction reduces debt and is structured as a private exchange, with no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for dilution impact, final VWAP settlement, and potential open-market selling pressure from noteholders receiving shares.
